models_evaluated: ten multimodal LLMs (others not named in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy and safety scores versus routine ward diagnoses and versus other LLMs on same cases
links.effect: All ten LLMs significantly outperformed routine ward diagnoses on average diagnostic and safety scores. LLM performance was tightly clustered (<15% variation) despite large cost differences.
links.quote: (ii) All LLMs significantly outperformed routine ward diagnoses on average diagnostic and safety scores.

unlisted_practices: Using a calibrated multi-model LLM jury to score outputs
Adding radiology reports as input to improve LLM diagnostic performance (6% gain)
Weighing model cost against marginal performance differences in LMIC settings

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark of multimodal LLMs on real-world inpatient EHR cases (imaging, notes, labs) measuring diagnostic accuracy, reasoning, safety, and cost, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
